scenarios.causalMutation: Emit two family/seed rows with the same row id.

diagnostics.message: Every matrix row id must be unique.

scenarios.causalMutation: Inject a family outside the supported Goal 058 family set.

diagnostics.message: Matrix family id must resolve to Goal 058 source families.

scenarios.causalMutation: Inject a seed outside the required seed set.

diagnostics.message: Matrix seed id must be one of seed_alpha, seed_beta or seed_gamma.
Public GamePackage schema mutation is forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Generate rows that differ only by row id while sharing all variation facts.

diagnostics.message: Rows require meaningful family/seed variation dimensions.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim arbitrary Lua execution while building the matrix.
Emit a preview/export matrix payload without row preview refs.

diagnostics.message: Every matrix row requires preview/export refs.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim real media generation, import or network download.

diagnostics.message: Goal 059 may only consume accepted fixture media evidence.

scenarios.causalMutation: Remove the Goal 058 campaign source manifest before loading.
Remove one required family x seed row.

diagnostics.message: The matrix must contain all 3 x 3 rows.

scenarios.causalMutation: Omit a matrix row marker from the Unity player log.

diagnostics.message: Unity matrix proof must contain required row markers.

scenarios.causalMutation: Rebuild a row from the same facts with different JSON or hash.

diagnostics.message: Replay proof must match JSON and hash for every row.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim provider, network, LLM or RAG execution.

diagnostics.message: Provider, network, LLM and RAG calls are forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Change a consumed Goal 058 artifact after its hash was recorded.

diagnostics.message: Source artifact bytes must match recorded hashes.

scenarios.causalMutation: Change Unity outside the deterministic matrix command-plan marker route.

diagnostics.message: Only narrow matrix marker support is allowed.

scenarios.causalMutation: Use absolute paths or traversal in matrix refs.

diagnostics.message: Matrix artifact refs must stay safe relative paths.
